RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from the available information.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your credentials make you a credible candidate, but the announcement doesn’t establish how your experience and interview performance compared against the selection criteria.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the assessment criteria, your scores and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate, subject to applicable disclosure rules.

Check local recruitment rules and complaint deadlines now; don’t assume waiting for a response extends them. Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related remarks, inconsistent treatment or departures from selection rules—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
